title: Tyler as secret space program mission controller since Challenger

tellings.quote: collaborating with the secret space program person he's a mission controller who's worked on all these missions since the Challenger in the ' 80s is wild

plain: The religion scholar Diana Pasulka has been working with a man called Tyler, who Michels says is a mission controller for a secret space program and has worked on all its missions since the time of the Challenger space shuttle in the 1980s. Michels says this himself, to Pasulka, and calls it wild. If true, it would mean a hidden space program has been running alongside the public one for decades.
